definitions: a piece of cloth or similar material, typically rectangular, attached to a pole or rope and used as a symbol of a country or institution, or as a signal.
a small marker, often a piece of cloth or plastic, used to indicate a particular spot or item.
a flat slab of stone or concrete, typically rectangular, used for paving.
examples: The Union Jack is the national flag of the United Kingdom.
They planted a flag on the summit.
The patio was made of flagstones.
